summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend test of the multi-user CallFlow CRM. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass (auth, RBAC, customers, bulk round-robin+dedupe, status/feedback, follow-ups, stats, reassign, attendance, settings). Found & fixed one critical backend bug: POST /api/attendance/check-in returned 500 (leaked MongoDB ObjectId in response after insert_one mutated the dict). Frontend: verified login (admin + emp1), wrong password error, emp1 sees only their 3 customers, header 'Hi, Employee 1' + 0/50, dial->status modal->'Interested' navigates to /feedback/[id], star rating + notes submit, follow-ups tab shows the interested customer, Progress tab shows attendance card + daily-goal ring, More tab correctly hides admin/settings rows for employees and shows them for admin, Settings save works, Admin reassign flow (filter emp2 -> select customer -> pick emp3) shows 'Reassigned 1 customers to emp3'. Sign-out returns to login. No deprecated Expo packages, no red-screen errors. Meta WhatsApp is stubbed in preview (expected).
action_items: None blocking. Optionally: on employee 'Interested' flow the app returns to home after feedback submit — confirm that is the intended UX (currently navigates to '/'). Consider popping back to previous screen (customer list) with a toast instead.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py check_in previously returned the dict mutated by motor's insert_one (contains ObjectId '_id') → 500 on FastAPI serialize. Fixed by popping _id before return.
server.py: JWT_SECRET default 'dev_secret_change' — production should require it (fail fast). Currently .env sets a real secret so OK for preview.

server.py bulk import silently drops rows with duplicate phone_norm inside the SAME payload — those are still counted as duplicates (correct), but the pre-check + try/except around insert_one is redundant; keep as defensive.
Push notifications endpoint requires EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY; placeholder in preview is expected — non-blocking, wrapped in try/except.
frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx AddCustomerModal from previous iteration still lacks KeyboardAvoidingView/ScrollView — carry-over item from iteration_1 if not yet addressed.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (login, RBAC, home, dial->status->feedback, follow-ups, progress, more, admin reassign, settings, sign-out all verified; attendance check-in button not observed because emp1 already had complete day from backend tests — expected)

seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing 18 seeded customers (round-robined across all 7 employees). All TEST_ data created during pytest was cleaned up by TestZCleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully tested via /app/backend/tests/test_callflow_api.py — reuse as regression suite. RUN suffix in phone numbers avoids collisions across re-runs. Meta WhatsApp is placeholder (expected). One critical backend bug fixed this iteration (ObjectId leak in attendance check-in).
rca_of_issue: POST /api/attendance/check-in returned 500 with 'ObjectId is not iterable'. RCA: motor's insert_one(doc) mutates the input dict by injecting '_id: ObjectId(...)'. The handler then returned the same doc directly (no projection filter possible on insert). FastAPI's jsonable_encoder tried to serialize the ObjectId and raised. Fix: pop '_id' from the doc before returning. Verified by re-running the full pytest suite (28/28 pass).
